## 修复

修复 Claude 聊天包含 HTML 字样的终端报错时，保存被 `HTML_CONTENT_REQUIRES_ADAPTER` 阻止的问题。普通文字中的 `<script>` 等内容现在按字面保留；代码块、行内代码和公式保持原样。该修复也适用于 Gemini 的同类内容。

下载 `ai-inbox-browser-0.5.1.zip`，将包内文件覆盖到原扩展目录，在 Chrome / Edge 扩展管理页点击“重新加载”，再刷新聊天页面并保存。Obsidian 插件继续使用 **0.5.0** 即可，无需重新配对。

## Fix

Fix saving Claude conversations whose pasted terminal errors contain literal HTML-looking text such as `<script>`. These characters are preserved as text instead of failing HTML validation. Code blocks, inline code and formulas remain unchanged. The same fix applies to Gemini.

Replace the files in your existing extension folder with `ai-inbox-browser-0.5.1.zip`, reload the extension, refresh the conversation and save again. Compatible with **Obsidian AI Inbox 0.5.0**; no plugin update or new pairing is needed.
